title: An executor runs a job as the identity its placement names, reading the credential from a 0600 file or a masked CI variable, and refuses a job whose credential is missing
goal: kj_cred.resolve(identity, group, operator, cred_dir, environ) gives the environment of the job's git: none disables every push (an invalid pushurl); group-bot reads cred_dir/group/<group path> or the CI variable KB_GROUP_TOKEN_<GROUP_PATH upper, / as _>; operator reads cred_dir/operator/<operator path>; the token reaches git only through a GIT_ASKPASS helper that reads the file, never argv or an environment value; a file with a group or other bit, or no credential, raises kj_cred.Refused naming the identity and the path or variable, and the job ends refused with that reason

run:
import sys,os,tempfile,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,os.path.abspath("_tools")); import kj_cred
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); f=os.path.join(d,"group","corp","ops"); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(f)); open(f,"w").write("tok-placeholder"); os.chmod(f,0o600)
e1=kj_cred.resolve("none","corp/ops","corp/ops/jan.kowalski",d,{})
e2=kj_cred.resolve("group-bot","corp/ops","corp/ops/jan.kowalski",d,{})
out=subprocess.run([e2["GIT_ASKPASS"],"Password for 'https://gitlab.corp.example.com':"],capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict(os.environ,**e2)).stdout.strip()
assert out=="tok-placeholder" and "tok-placeholder" not in "".join(e2.values()) and "tok-placeholder" not in "".join(e1.values()), (e1,e2)
e3=kj_cred.resolve("group-bot","corp/dev","corp/dev/anna.nowak",d,{"KB_GROUP_TOKEN_CORP_DEV":"ci-placeholder"})
assert e3.get("GIT_ASKPASS"), e3
for args in (("operator","corp/ops","corp/ops/jan.kowalski"),("group-bot","corp/qa","corp/qa/piotr.nowak")):
    try: kj_cred.resolve(*args,d,{}); assert False, args
    except kj_cred.Refused as x: assert args[0] in str(x), x
os.chmod(f,0o644)
try: kj_cred.resolve("group-bot","corp/ops","corp/ops/jan.kowalski",d,{}); assert False
except kj_cred.Refused as x: assert "0600" in str(x), x
